title: QC Walk Before "Done"
short_answer: The five-to-ten-minute walk that decides whether Job Check advances. Raking light tells the truth; hope does not.
summary: The five-to-ten-minute walk that decides whether Job Check advances. Raking light tells the truth; hope does not.
plain_words: Do not mark a stage complete because the crew is tired or the GC is waiting. Walk it. Use light at a low angle. If you would be embarrassed to hand the phone to a finisher or a painter, it is not done.
when_to_use: Before advancing any Job Check stage chip
Leadership pass before the office or GC trusts the board
Notes column context when a stage is borderline
prerequisites: Stage work claimed complete enough to walk
Bright light available for raking pass

tools.name: Low-tack tape or pencil for marking

steps.body: Bring a bright light you can hold near-parallel to the wall (raking light).
Mark outside the defect — low-tack tape or pencil, never marker (marker bleeds).
Photo representative fails if the crew needs a teaching moment or the office needs evidence.
Only then update Job Check. Status is a promise to the next trade and to the office.
Ship / fix / call: ship if it passes; fix if it is our work; call if it is scope, rating, or another trade's damage.

warnings.title: The expensive work is the work you do twice
warnings.body: Scraping deletes sanding. Layout deletes butt joints. A QC walk deletes remobilization. Front-load the cheap step.

variations.title: Framing
changes: Pass: layout true; studs on module; backing present; RO correct
Fix: missing backing, wrong gauge/spacing, head-of-wall guesswork

variations.title: Hang
changes: Pass: factory edges used; fasteners set; cutouts clean; rated layers match listing
Fix: forced board, proud screws, boarded-over wrong MEP

variations.title: Scrap
changes: Pass: high spots shaved; dirt/dust off for tape

variations.title: Finish
changes: Pass: coat sequence honest; level matches spec; no telegraphing ridges
Fix: advancing coats over green mud; Level 5 never confirmed

variations.title: ACT
changes: Pass: level grid; equal borders; wires on structure; clean tile
Fix: wires on duct; dirty borders; seismic carried from last job wrongly

variations.title: Punch
changes: Pass: drywall defects fixed before paint touch-up
Fix: paint over dust or unprimed compound

quality_checks.prompt: Walked with raking light at a low angle
Each visible defect is ship, fix, or call — not hope
Job Check updated only after the walk passes

common_mistakes.title: Advancing on hope
common_mistakes.wrong: Flip the chip because the GC is waiting or the crew is tired
common_mistakes.right: Walk it with raking light first
common_mistakes.why: Status is a promise to the next trade and the office

common_mistakes.title: Marker on finish
common_mistakes.right: Low-tack tape or pencil outside the defect
common_mistakes.why: Marker bleeds through primer and paint

provenance.note: GVC practice + GA-214 finish levels (see Finishing). Raking-light ritual also drives Drywall Touch-Up. No production rates — stage history in Job Check is the real measure later.
